summary: st tells a Fabric refusal from a fault by the error code and class Fabric prints with --json, instead of matching words on its stderr.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: st now runs `fabric dial --json` and reads `{"address"}`, `{"socket"}` or the `{"error"}` object. Fabric builds older than 0.2.41 reject --json with exit 2; st then runs the old command and reads the old refusal words in one fallback, so older members keep replicating and attaching. Remove the fallback once no member runs Fabric older than 0.2.41. Replication wire formats are unchanged.

manual.detail: No manual step. A member that wants the codes updates Fabric with `fabric update`.
